Jira is Published with Persuasive metadata for R5; the issue body still shows an auto-deferred resolution note, and the applied comment says the work was done and should be checked when moving to the new IG framework.
initial_application: No current commit message explicitly names FHIR-12898. Git pickaxe history shows the old in-repo IG Publisher gained the requested behavior in 30c987904f989a4bd809082e8ea9fe4d30fa3529, which added better support for Markdown in page files, including md-template, GuidePageGeneration.MARKDOWN, .md source lookup for .html pages, and Markdown intro/notes includes.
additional_context: The old IG Publisher Java source was removed from FHIR core by 56ceb0df08dd72381a4f98f1ea4ac5ea6d139a8b with the explicit reason "Remove IG publisher (it's gone to Maven)". The current core checkout has no Java Publisher source and no build reference to tools/ig, while the current HL7/fhir-ig-publisher repository still contains Markdown page/template handling. Zulip evidence after the Jira resolution shows Markdown pages in the IG Publisher were being used; Confluence and exact-key Zulip searches found no conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source files were changed. The current authoritative implementation surface for this request is the external IG Publisher repository, not the current core specification build.
